title: Layout-Aware PDF Parse
goal: Extract document text with layout or bounding-box awareness so builders can preserve reading order, citations, tables, and page context.

primary_tools.name: LlamaParse
primary_tools.role: Cloud parsing API for structured document parsing with bounding-box metadata

primary_tools.name: LiteParse
primary_tools.license: Verify upstream repository license before use
primary_tools.role: Local open-source parser from the LlamaIndex/LlamaParse ecosystem

when_to_use: You need layout-aware extraction, bounding boxes, or citation coordinates.
The PDF has multi-column pages, tables, scans, or visual structure that plain text extraction may destroy.
You want to build RAG, citation, compliance, or portfolio review workflows that point back to document locations.
when_not_to_use: A simple Markdown conversion is enough.
You cannot send files to a cloud parser and have not configured a local alternative.
You need guaranteed extraction accuracy without manual review.

demo.notes: No third-party tool is executed. This fixture illustrates the expected page/block/bounding-box structure for a layout-aware parser.

codex_prompt: Use a layout-aware document parsing workflow. Extract text blocks with page numbers and, where available, bounding boxes. Preserve reading order, flag uncertain tables or OCR regions, and produce a Markdown summary plus a JSON structure suitable for citations.
verification: Each extracted block has page context.
Bounding boxes or layout metadata are present when the selected tool supports them.
Tables and multi-column sections are marked for manual review if uncertain.
No unsupported accuracy claim is made.
risks: Cloud parsing may expose sensitive documents; require explicit user consent.
Bounding boxes do not guarantee semantic correctness.
Tool terms, pricing, and supported file types can change and must be checked before runner implementation.
